Declare which column an anipoint is indexed by

Source: R/variables_index.R
set_index.Rd

Shorthand for set_variables(data, when = list(index = column)). The frame is re-sorted. A column that was a when key stops being one; the previous index becomes an undeclared column rather than a key.

Usage

set_index(data, column)

Arguments

data

An anipoint object.

column

Length-one character vector naming the index column. It must exist in data and be numeric.

Value

data, re-indexed and restructured.

See also

get_index()

Examples

df <- data.frame(frame = 1:3, individual = "a", x = c(1, 2, 3), y = c(0, 1, 0))
af <- as_anipoint(df, index = "frame")
get_index(af)
#> [1] "frame"
